actual_leader.name: Hissene Habre
actual_leader.note: Took power 7 Jun 1982 (acting head of state), formally president from 29 Oct 1982; the earlier date is used as the start of his rule. Led UNIR from its founding on 24 Jun 1984.
actual_leader.office: President of the Republic and leader of UNIR

actual_leader.note: Executive president under the 1980 constitution; tied to the PNC party row rather than the identically-named Party pillar.

emergent.described: the northern forces under President Saleh's officers

actual_leader.note: On 1 Jan 1990 Yemen was two states (unified 22 May 1990). The roster carries one Yemen with the unified table, whose Army pillar is named for Saleh's officers; Saleh is the face and the southern leadership sits in also. worldstatesmen gives al-Beidh's Presidium chair from 25 Jan 1986 and party post from 6 Feb 1986; Wikipedia's infobox gives 6 Feb 1986 for the party post. rulers.org ruly.html returned 404.
actual_leader.office: President of the Yemen Arab Republic

emergent.described: the Forcas Populares de Libertacao de Mocambique

actual_leader.note: FRELIMO party leader from 1986 on succeeding Machel.

Decided case: Army tie, bloc_override Islamist - the coup was backed by the National Islamic Front and Bashir allied with Turabi. Turabi held no formal office on 1 Jan 1990 (arrested after the coup, parties banned), so he is not in also.
actual_leader.office: Chairman of the Revolutionary Command Council for National Salvation

also.name: Sultan Ali Keshtmand
also.office: Chairman of the Council of Ministers

actual_leader.name: Mohammad Najibullah
actual_leader.note: Regime rule: general secretary. Najibullah took the party post 4 May 1986 and the presidency 30 Nov 1987; since is the party date. worldstatesmen.org/Afghanistan.html returned 404 twice this run.
actual_leader.office: General Secretary of the PDPA and President of the Republic

actual_leader.note: SLORC chairman and prime minister were the same man; the SLORC chairmanship is the executive. Army officer, tied to the Tatmadaw. worldstatesmen.org/Myanmar.html returned 404 twice this run.
actual_leader.office: Chairman of the State Law and Order Restoration Council

actual_leader.name: Mengistu Haile Mariam
actual_leader.note: since is the WPE general secretaryship (12 Sep 1984), the office that carried power; the PDRE presidency followed on 10 Sep 1987. Lieutenant colonel, but by 1990 ruled through the party, so the tie is et_wpe.
actual_leader.office: President of the People's Democratic Republic and General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Ethiopia

actual_leader.note: worldstatesmen lists 20 Sep 1979, Wikipedia says he took office 21 Sep 1979; the inauguration date is used. No prime minister (post abolished 1978-1991). The 1990 US Department of State report identifies the governing MPLA-PT as Marxist-Leninist. The opening Communist override describes that government, not the later multiparty MPLA row used by the dormant election table. See docs/political-arm/1990-census-reconciliation.md.
actual_leader.office: President of the Republic and President of the MPLA-PT
